import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and aggregate revenue by month and region
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
grouped = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for region, group in grouped.groupby('region'):
    group = group.sort_values('month')
    ax.plot(group['month'], group['revenue'], marker='o', label=region)

ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
